name: Custom Corrugated Shipping Boxes
seo_title: Custom Corrugated Shipping Boxes in Vietnam | VPN
seo_description: Source custom corrugated shipping boxes in Vietnam. Request a quote for printed 0201/RSC cartons by inside size, packed weight, board and quantity.
excerpt:
VPN Packaging Factory in Vietnam handles bulk sourcing enquiries for custom corrugated shipping boxes. The 0201 regular slotted carton has four flaps at each end, with the two outer flaps meeting at the centre. Share the inside size, gross packed weight, print layout and quantity to start a quotation.

Gallery images are AI-generated design illustrations.

specs.label: Box structure

specs.label: Size to quote
specs.value: Inside length × width × height in mm. Give the maximum outside dimensions separately if a pallet, carrier or packing line has a limit.

specs.label: Board to review
specs.value: Single-wall or double-wall corrugated board after review of packed weight, stacking conditions and travel route.

specs.label: Print and closure

specs.value: Quantity per size and design, required arrival date, and delivery city in Vietnam or destination country.
